items.title: Toxic
items.overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

items.title: Premada Oorali
items.overview: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

items.overview: While exploring Kantara's mystical forest, Bangra's King Vijayendra dies during the Kadamba reign. Rajashekara seals their realm. Prince Kulashekara massacres to reopen it. Berme, seeking wealth, crosses the divide.

items.title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
items.overview: A period drama set in the 1970s, KGF follows the story of a fierce rebel who rises against the brutal oppression in Kolar Gold Fields and becomes the symbol of hope to legions of downtrodden people.

items.title: Saaku Magalu
items.overview: 1963 Kannada movie starring Dr. Rajkumar and Sowcar Janaki in lead roles. It was directed by B.R. Pantulu.

items.title: KD – The Devil
items.overview: In the early 1970s, a petty criminal Kaali unwittingly involves himself with underworld thugs, catalyzing events beyond his control.

items.title: Family Drama
items.overview: Welcome to the Family of Liars... Cheaters...Murderers? Here's the Sneak Peek of Family Drama, a Dark Comedy Kannada film.

items.title: Bete
items.overview: The plot revolves around a protagonist whose prowess in overcoming challenges makes him a legend. The title "Bete" likely refers to his relentless pursuit of enemies, a quality that makes him a powerful and feared figure.

items.title: Mahavatar Narsimha
items.overview: Tyrannical demon Hiranyakashyap challenges Vishnu, proclaiming himself a god. However, his son Prahlad remains devoted to Vishnu, who appears as Narsimha to defeat the demon.

items.title: Inspector Vikram
items.overview: Inspector Vikram is the typical do-gooder cop, who also entertains and ensures no crime is left unsolved. What happens when he gets to meet a villain who is smarter than the average criminal and heads a drug racket?

items.title: Border Diaries
items.overview: Set in an industrial area on the Karnataka-Tamil Nadu border, the story explores the lives of people working there and focuses on emotional borders, love, morality, and survival.

items.title: Martin
items.overview: Martin revolves around Lt. Brigadier Arjun Saxena, whose journey takes him from Pakistan to India to discover his real identity and fight against black market dealers, who are involved with terrorists to orchestrate massive attacks in the country.
